title: Steve-Text
label: STEVE-TEXT

subpages.alt: Steve Robertson in a grey cap and a dark fleece jacket, drawn in red, yellow and white block graphics.

subpages: A developer portfolio built as a European Teletext service. You are looking at it.
The portrait on part 1 started as a photo. A build step turns pictures into Teletext block graphics: each cell holds 2 × 3 pixels in two of the eight colours.
